human_value.why_value_not_ranker: Value net is a SIGNAL (argmax E[dV], rank-invariant), not a POLICY, so broadening its training distribution to all ascensions improves the high-A states where the A0-only net was OOD with NO specialize-vs-generalize tax. The scalar-conditioned RANKER multi-ascension attempt was FALSIFIED on the same harness (-2.12 blend, A0 tax that bought nothing) precisely because a single ranker cannot be an A0 specialist AND an A1-A10 generalist.

value_net_dropped.decision: v0.107.1 ships with NO value net (V-pathing OFF). bead sts2-rs-oh5pa.
value_net_dropped.evidence: The value net is used ONLY for Phase::MapChoice (V-pathing) in build_ranker (arena.rs:553); shop-oracle + card-refine were off. Paired rel-500 eval-cheap, ranker fixed: v0.107 ranker s0 value-OFF 197/500 (39.4%) vs value_s0 151 / value_s1 171 / value_s2 162 — OFF beats value_s0 +46 (+9.2pp, McNemar p=0.0002), beats best init s1 +26 (p=0.048); ALL 3 value inits lose to OFF. DECISIVE cross-check on the v0.103.2 engine with the DEPLOYED prod nets (ranker_chain500 + value_human_a0): value-OFF 235/500 (47.0%) vs value-ON 203/500 (40.6%) => OFF +32 (+6.4pp, p=0.0076). So V-pathing is net-negative on BOTH engines — NOT a v0.107 corpus problem.
value_net_dropped.root_cause: The value net is an OUTCOME predictor (target = final act reached, combat-dominated) misused as a local pathing POLICY on OFF-DISTRIBUTION projected agent states. HeuristicV (hand-built economy/HP/scaling, projection.rs::scored_first_cols) generalizes; the learned V does not. The historical 'value net is a positive lever' bless was an ARTIFACT — only net-vs-net (A0 vs all-asc) / ranker+value-together was ever tested; net-vs-OFF was NEVER run until 2026-06-27.
value_net_dropped.production_implication: main (v0.103.2) currently deploys value-ON and is leaving ~6pp on the table per the cross-check above. Separate fix — re-anchor on release-2000 before changing the deployed config. The human run corpus feeds ONLY the value net; with it dropped, the deployed agent uses no human-run data (ranker=self-play, combat=MCTS+Texel, pathing/shop=HeuristicV). Corpus still backs the win-rate-vs-humans benchmark + the planned deck-completion prior.

silent_research_v107.status: RESEARCH ARTIFACT — NOT DEPLOYED, do NOT wire into `recommended`. The deployed ranker is a single GLOBAL net used for every character; a Silent-only net would regress the other characters (there is no per-CharacterId net selection in run_arena). Archived here to preserve the training, not to ship. GH #194.
silent_research_v107.what: First-ever Silent-specialized card ranker for v0.107.1. All prior rankers (full500/chain500/ranker_v107) were trained Ironclad-A0-only, so their Silent per-card embeddings were never touched by gradient (BLIND on Silent). Built by heuristic-bootstrap expert iteration: driver lineage --policy heuristic -> iter1_s2 -> iter2_s2 -> iter3_s2 (this net = iter3 init s2). Value net OFF.
silent_research_v107.eval: 500 disjoint held-out Silent seeds, A0, eval-cheap, value-OFF (paired exact-McNemar). Blind ranker_v107 (deployed) = 28/500 (5.6%). This net = 83/500 (16.6%), d=+55 vs blind, p<1e-8 (~3x). Expert iteration plateaued: iter1 47 -> iter2 74 -> iter3 83 -> iter4 81 (best=iter3_s2; two non-improving rounds confirmed convergence).
silent_research_v107.known_gap: Still far below the Ironclad ranker's ~39% (release-2000). Root cause is COMBAT-SIDE, not ranker training (GH #194): (1) more combat sims does NOT help (eval-cheap vs eval-strong p=0.85); (2) the char-agnostic combat leaf + fight_delta labels do not credit Silent's superlinear engine (poison stacking / shiv loops), so the ranker drafts generic decks that get out-scaled at the act-2 boss (48% of deaths). Closing the gap needs the value machinery to credit ENGINE ASSEMBLY — a research project, not a ranker retrain. See branch feat/poison-aware-combat-leaf for a first combat-leaf step (poison as pending damage).
